issues.legal_issue: A memorandum that records a completed equitable mortgage by deposit of title deeds, rather than itself creating the security, does not require registration.
material_facts: The money was advanced and the hundies were executed in the morning.
That afternoon, the borrower brought the title deeds to the creditor; the deeds were examined and approved, and a list of them was made.
The letter stated that the deeds had been delivered and deposited to create security and that the borrower would execute a formal mortgage when called upon.
The majority construed the evidence as showing that the equitable mortgage had been completed by the deposit of the deeds before the letter was given.
issues.conclusion: The letter did not require registration and was admissible as evidence. The appeal was dismissed, leaving the mortgage decree in place.
issues.legal_principle: Under the Registration Act, a document requires registration when it is an operative instrument that creates or declares an interest in property; a memorandum that merely records a transaction already completed does not. The document must be read in its context, and its wording cannot be altered to make it operative. The majority relied on United Bank of India v. Lakharam Sonaram and referred to Hari Sankar Paul v. Kedar Nath Saha; it rejected any broad reading of Kedarnath Dutt v. Shamlall Khettry that would require registration for a document that does not, properly construed, disclose the creation of a mortgage.

rule.if: mortgage_decree_appeal and memorandum_records_title_deed_deposit and (deposit_completed_before_memorandum or memorandum_not_operative)

predicates.mortgage_decree_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning a decree based on a mortgage.
predicates.memorandum_records_title_deed_deposit: A document records the deposit of title deeds as security for a debt.
predicates.deposit_completed_before_memorandum: The title deeds were deposited and the security was created before the memorandum was given.
predicates.memorandum_not_operative: The memorandum recites an earlier deposit or transaction rather than itself creating the security.

issues.definition: If an appeal concerns a mortgage decree and a memorandum records a title-deed deposit, the memorandum is admissible without registration when the deposit preceded it or the memorandum merely records the transaction rather than creating the security.
